closed.title: Candidate readiness owner and cache boundary
closed.detail: ModelReadinessRegistry is already keyed by provider selection identity. ProviderFactory can create a candidate independently, while only AgentRuntimeAdapter._installProvider mutates service.provider, service.agent.provider and providerSelection. The existing readiness probe logic can therefore be applied to a candidate object without changing active authority.
